prompt: Why does the woman ask the man to remove a page from each folder?
promptZh: 女子為什麼請男子從每個資料夾抽掉一頁？

options.text: To make room for a practice schedule
options.zh: 要騰出空間放排練時程表
options.whyZh: 資料夾要放更正後的歌譜頁，不是時程表。

options.text: To keep singers from using the wrong ending
options.zh: 避免團員唱到舊版的結尾
options.whyZh: 如果新舊兩頁都留著，團員可能不知道該唱哪一個結尾。

options.text: To keep the print shop from charging for extra copies
options.whyZh: 抽出舊頁不是為了避免影印費；對話沒談費用。

options.text: To create extra copies for the conductor
options.whyZh: 舊頁結尾已過時，不適合拿來當額外歌譜。

explanationZh: 如果新舊兩頁都留著，團員可能不知道該唱哪一個結尾。
evidence: Only the ending changed. | Please take the old page out, too. We can't stop rehearsal to explain which ending to sing.

vocabulary.note: take out 和 put in 是相反動作；更換頁面不只是加一頁。
